mechanism: Atazanavir (CYP3A4 inhibitor) increases chloroquine plasma concentrations, elevating risk of chloroquine toxicity including QT prolongation and arrhythmias; both drugs also have QT-prolonging potential.
action: Avoid combination if possible; if necessary, reduce chloroquine dose, monitor ECG and QTc interval closely, and assess for signs of chloroquine toxicity including visual disturbances and cardiac arrhythmias.
